narrative.overview:
One accent, everywhere it appears, means the same thing: this is real and it works. Desaturated teal is the only color in the system besides ink-on-white — no second brand hue, no status-color vocabulary to learn. Everything else is slate: near-black text, mid-slate secondary text, a hairline border to separate sections instead of gray fill panels.

This is a product surface: a developer-hub layout built to prove the @zhunam/* libraries work, not to sell a story. It rejects the AI-generated-portfolio look — no cream/beige background, no gradient text, no repeated uppercase eyebrow, no fabricated version numbers or fake terminal logs. Every fact shown is something actually true of the code today.
keyCharacteristics: Pure white page background, no gray section fills — regions separated by spacing and a single hairline border.
One accent (teal) used deliberately: primary actions, the one live status badge, focus rings.
One type family, hierarchy from weight and size — a two-tone hero heading is the one place color carries typographic emphasis.
The one dark surface (console panel) uses a separately-tuned lighter teal, because the base teal fails contrast on dark.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only brand color. A badge is either filled teal (live) or plain slate-outlined (informational). Never invent a second accent.

rules.name: The No-Fill-Section Rule
rules.body: Never use a gray background to separate a region. Separation comes from spacing and a hairline border, never bg-slate-100/200 panels.

rules.name: The Single-Face Rule
rules.body: No second typeface, licensed or system. Every hierarchy level is the same family; only weight, size, and (once, in the hero) color change.

rules.name: The Ghost-Card Refusal
rules.body: Never pair a 1px border with a box-shadow on the same element.

dos: Do use Signal Teal as the only accent, used deliberately.
Do separate sections with spacing and a single hairline border, never a gray fill.
Do use the lightened #8ba7a6 teal (not the base #2c5f5d) on the dark console panel.
Do show only verifiable facts in the console panel and library cards.
Do render Coming Soon library entries as non-interactive elements, never a dead link.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color for status/info.
Don't add a bg-slate-100/200 fill to separate a section.
Don't fabricate a version number, build log, or usage statistic.
Don't pair a 1px border with a box-shadow on the same card.
Don't load a second typeface via Google Fonts or any external font CDN.
Don't link a nav item, button, or sidebar entry to a page that doesn't exist.
